Do I contradict myself?
Very well then I contradict myself,
(I am large, I contain multitudes.)

author.bio: Walt Whitman repeatedly expanded and revised Leaves of Grass, the poetry collection first issued in 1855. His long, open-ended lines made the individual speaker a meeting place for many voices and experiences.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The lines arrive late in Song of Myself, where the speaker is still inviting a listener into conversation. The complete section ↗ continues with questions about shared time and companionship, placing the famous claim of multitudes inside an encounter rather than a standalone slogan.
